Upgrade visuals/animations in `C:\Users\Keigo\.cursor\projects\empty-window\index.html` ONLY. **Do NOT break game logic** (4-player riichi, yaku, calls, beginner panel, scoring, etc.). Changes: HTML structure tweaks only if needed for effects, CSS heavily, small JS for animation classes only (no rule changes).

## Design requirements (user spec)

1. **Premium table background**
   - Deep felt green (`#1b5e20` + gradients), NOT flat cheap green
   - Wood frame around table via border/box-shadow (luxury mahjong table)

2. **3D Unicode tiles (`.tile`)**
   - Ivory gradient background (not flat white)
   - Depth via border-bottom + box-shadow (back edge cyan/green feel)
   - Color-code tile glyphs by suit where possible: man=red, pin=blue/red, sou=green, honors=gold/black — use data attributes or JS class on tile index when rendering (existing `populateTileElement` / render paths)

3. **Rich animations**
   - Human hand tiles: smooth hover lift (`transition`)
   - On discard/draw: brief glow or smooth motion (CSS classes toggled from existing discard/draw functions — minimal JS hooks)
   - Win overlay: golden text, confetti via CSS animation (no external assets)

4. **Cyber-modern UI**
   - CPU seat panels: sci-fi borders, blinking LED-style "thinking" indicator when `cpu_think` phase
   - Message/guide area: neon glow or modern popup styling, keep readable Japanese text

## Constraints
- Single file, no external URLs/images/fonts CDN
- Preserve Unicode tile display fixes
- Keep responsive layout with beginner side panel
- Japanese comments for new CSS/JS sections

## Process
1. Read full file
2. Add CSS variables for theme (felt, wood, neon, gold)
3. Update render functions ONLY to add classes like `tile--man`, `tile--pin`, `tile--sou`, `tile--honor`, animation classes on draw/discard/win
4. Test mentally that event listeners unchanged

Return: brief list of CSS classes added and which JS hooks trigger animations.

content.text:
Visual upgrades are in `C:\Users\Keigo\.cursor\projects\empty-window\index.html` only. Game logic, listeners, and rules are unchanged.

## CSS classes added

| Class | Role |
|--------|------|
| `tile--man` / `tile--pin` / `tile--sou` / `tile--honor` | Suit glyph colors (pin even ranks also use red via `data-tile`) |
| `tile--flash` | Brief glow on draw/discard |
| `tile--with-fallback` | Unchanged — Unicode fallback labels |
| `seat--cpu` | Cyber panel frame for CPU seats |
| `seat--thinking` | Active CPU seat pulse during `cpu_think` |
| `cpu-led`, `cpu-led-dot` | Blinking “THINK” LED row |
| `msg--pulse` | Neon pulse on `#message` update |
| `phase--*` (on `body`) | e.g. `phase--cpu_think` for turn-line styling |
| `win-confetti-layer` | CSS confetti on win overlay |
| `overlay--celebrate` | Win overlay show state (with confetti) |

Theme variables: `--felt`, `--wood-*`, `--neon-*`, `--gold`, `--tile-ivory-*`, `--tile-man/pin/sou/honor`.

Layout: `#table-wrap` (wood rim), `#table-surface` (felt).

## JS hooks (animation only)

| Hook | Trigger |
|------|---------|
| `applyTileSuitClass()` | Inside `populateTileElement()` on every tile |
| `flashHumanDrawnTile()` | After `renderAll()` in `cpuOrHumanStep` (human draw), `startKyoku` (dealer start), `finishCallTurn(true)`, `doAnkan`, `doKakan` |
| `flashLastRiverTile(seat)` | After `renderAll()` in `cpuTurn`, `humanDiscard` |
| `pulseMessage()` | Inside `setMessage()` |
| `syncPhaseUi()` | End of `renderAll()` — body `phase--*`, CPU `seat--thinking`, injects `.cpu-led` |
| `overlay--celebrate` | `resolveWin()` adds; `btnWinClose` removes |

Existing classes still used: `clickable`, `drawn`, `hint`, `dim`, `riichi-discard`, `last-discard`, `rotated`, `show` (overlays).
